Default. Performs a real client_credentials handshake against the token endpoint, verifying both IdP availability and credential validity.
GETs the OIDC discovery document only. Lighter and credential-free, but a rotated secret won't be caught.
Default. Transient failures (IOException, 5xx, 429) clear the cache and report DOWN. Health answers 'is the IdP reachable right now'.
Transient failures return the still-naturally-valid cached token with stale=true. Health answers 'do we hold a usable token'. 4xx other than 429 still reports DOWN.
